Such units are provable FROM the interface; the deferral is the interface's EXISTENCE for a real classifier history, never its content. All other units are provable outright.
statement_fence: Statements are verbatim below and were elaboration-tested (twice). Do NOT weaken a statement to prove it; do NOT edit MovesC/Defs.lean without re-running the elaboration sample (new shared defs go in MovesC/Defs2.lean).

units.statement: theorem C0_coordPrec_trichotomy (c c' : Coord) : CoordPrec c c' ∨ c = c' ∨ CoordPrec c' c
units.moves_ref: §C.0 the global order ≺
units.sketch: ≺ (level asc, index desc) is a strict linear order on ℕ×ℕ; trichotomy by Nat trichotomy on levels then indices. Pure omega/rcases.

units.statement: theorem C0_coordPrec_trans (a b c : Coord) (h1 : CoordPrec a b) (h2 : CoordPrec b c) : CoordPrec a c
units.moves_ref: §C.0 the global order ≺
units.sketch: Transitivity of the lex order (level asc, index desc). Pure omega/case split.

units.statement: theorem C0_coordSort (n N : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ∃ f : Fin (n * N) → Coord, (∀ j, (f j).1 < N ∧ (f j).2 < n) ∧ ∀ j j' : Fin (n * N), j < j' ↔ CoordPrec (f j) (f j')
units.moves_ref: §C.0 'solve in ≺-order': the ≺-SORTED enumeration of the n×N box
units.sketch: ROUND 2 (round-1 audit: 'cardinal equivalence only; no sorting property'). Explicit enumeration f j := (j / n, n − 1 − j % n): level-major, index-descending within a level — exactly ≺. Order property by j = (j/n)·n + j%n arithmetic (omega). Injectivity/surjectivity onto the box follow but are not needed: the order-iff + range clause IS the sorting content, and witnesses JetSetup.coordOf's consistency (non-vacuity of the chart fields).

units.statement: theorem C0_digitSystemMass {m : ℕ} (D : Locus p m) : D.mass = p ^ (m - D.numPinned)
units.moves_ref: §C.0 BLOCK CONVENTION; D.3(e)(ii)/D.11 count law
units.sketch: Specialization of the accepted L2_P6ii DigitSystem count |α|^{n−k} to α = ZMod p (Nat.card (ZMod p) = p for p prime). Reuses LeanUrat.Moves.L2_P6ii verbatim.

units.statement: theorem C0_solvedGraph {m : ℕ} (D : Locus p m) : ∃ E : {x : Fin m → ZMod p // D.IsSolution x} ≃ ({j : Fin m // D.pinned j = false} → ZMod p), ∀ (x : {x : Fin m → ZMod p // D.IsSolution x}) (j : {j : Fin m // D.pinned j = false}), E x j = x.1 j.1
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5' 'solve Σ_i's system in ≺-order (graph over free coordinates)'
units.sketch: The restriction-to-free-coordinates map is an equiv: injective (pinned coords are solve of earlier, strong induction) and surjective (extend a free assignment by well-founded recursion — the `extend` device of L2_P6ii_R3, replayed openly). The extra clause pins E to BE the restriction map (round-1 lesson: no bare cardinal equivalences).

units.statement: theorem C0_pinWelldef {m : ℕ} (D D' : Locus p m) (h : ∀ x, D.IsSolution x ↔ D'.IsSolution x) : D.numPinned = D'.numPinned
units.moves_ref: §C.0.5 PIN-WELLDEF (cardinality half)
units.sketch: Same solution set ⟹ same mass; both are p^{m−numPinned} (C0.digitSystemMass); p ≥ 2 and numPinned ≤ m pin the exponent (Nat.pow injectivity).

units.statement: theorem C0_pinStatus {m : ℕ} (D D' : Locus p m) (h : ∀ x, D.IsSolution x ↔ D'.IsSolution x) : ∀ j : Fin m, D.pinned j = D'.pinned j
units.moves_ref: §C.0.5 PIN-WELLDEF, rev-9 scope: cardinality AND per-coordinate free/determined STATUS ('solve in ≺-order and compare status level by level')
units.sketch: ROUND 2 (round-1 audit: pinWelldef 'gives pin count only'). The projection of the solution set to coordinates ≤ j is the solution set of the truncated system (equations only reference earlier coords; extend forward), so its cardinality is p^{(j+1)−#pinned≤j}; hence #pinned≤j is determined by the locus for every j, hence pinned j is. Induction on j with the truncated count.

units.statement: theorem C0_unitriBij {m : ℕ} {Θ : (Fin m → ZMod p) → (Fin m → ZMod p)} (h : IsUnitriangular Θ) : Function.Bijective Θ
units.moves_ref: §C.0.5 (unitriangular ⟹ bijection, both directions)
units.sketch: Invert coordinate by coordinate in ≺-order: (Θx)_i = x_i + corr_i(earlier), so x_i is recovered from Θx by strong recursion on i. Injective + surjective.

units.statement: theorem C0_moveMass {m : ℕ} (D : Locus p m) {Θ : (Fin m → ZMod p) → (Fin m → ZMod p)} (h : Function.Bijective Θ) : Nat.card {x : Fin m → ZMod p // D.IsSolution (Θ x)} = D.mass
units.moves_ref: §C.2 move maps are global digit-level bijections (Fact A/B): mass preserved
units.sketch: Equiv.ofBijective Θ restricts to {x // D.IsSol (Θx)} ≃ {y // D.IsSol y}; Nat.card_congr.

units.statement: theorem C0_pinTransport {m : ℕ} (D : Locus p m) {Θ : (Fin m → ZMod p) → (Fin m → ZMod p)} (h : IsUnitriangular Θ) : ∃ D' : Locus p m, (∀ x, D'.IsSolution x ↔ D.IsSolution (Θ x)) ∧ ∀ j : Fin m, D'.pinned j = D.pinned j
units.moves_ref: §C.0.5 pin-transport corollary: Θ*(E) is a digit system with the same pins
units.sketch: ROUND 2: SAME PINNED FUNCTION (round-1 audit: 'same count, not the same pin coordinates/status'). Constructive: D'.pinned := D.pinned; D'.solve j f := D.solve j (Θ-image of the earlier coordinates) − corr_j(f) — the Θ-image of coordinates < j is a function of coordinates < j (unitriangularity), and x solves D' iff Θx solves D by the diagonal-plus-correction shape.

units.statement: theorem C1_stripClause {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m) : ∃ cl : LevelClause p m, cl.support = {c} ∧ cl.codim = 1 ∧ ∀ x : Fin m → ZMod p, cl.sat x ↔ x c = 0
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5'(1) fresh STRIP clauses: literal zeros, each cuts p⁻¹
units.sketch: Construct the clause: support {c}, codim 1, sat x := x c = 0; dep is immediate; count: the supported satisfying set is exactly {0}, so 1·p¹ = p^|{c}|. Non-vacuity witness for LevelClause.

units.statement: theorem C1_TYP_fiberCount {m : ℕ} {S : Finset (Fin m)} {α : Type*} [AddCommGroup α] [Fintype α] (T : TypObject p m S α) (v : α) : Nat.card {y : Fin m → ZMod p // T.φ y = v ∧ ∀ c ∉ S, y c = 0} * Nat.card α = p ^ S.card
units.moves_ref: §C Lemma TYP(b): the piece map is an additive surjection ⟹ equal kernel-coset fibers ⟹ the value clause cuts (alphabet)⁻¹
units.sketch: The supported subgroup V := {y | y ≡ 0 off S} has card p^{|S|}; φ|V is still surjective (dep: every x has a supported representative with the same φ-value); fibers of an additive surjection are kernel cosets, all of size |V|/|α|. TypObject itself (that the real fresh value digit IS such a surjection) is the deferred graded piece.

units.statement: theorem C1_TYP_toClause {m : ℕ} {S : Finset (Fin m)} {α : Type*} [AddCommGroup α] [Fintype α] (T : TypObject p m S α) (v : α) (a : ℕ) (hcard : Nat.card α = p ^ a) : ∃ cl : LevelClause p m, cl.support = S ∧ cl.codim = a ∧ ∀ x : Fin m → ZMod p, cl.sat x ↔ T.φ x = v
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5'(1) fresh VALUE clauses are TYP content: the graded fiber count IS a LevelClause (Route B — the value clause enters the counting ONLY through this bridge; round-1 audit: 'conditionalMass does not consume TypObject at all' — repaired by construction)
units.sketch: Package sat := (φ · = v) with support S, codim a; dep := T.dep; count := C1.TYP_fiberCount rewritten by hcard.

units.statement: theorem C1_clausesCount {m : ℕ} (fd : FreshData p m) : Nat.card {x : Fin m → ZMod p // fd.sat x} * p ^ fd.mstar = p ^ m
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5'(1) 'pairwise disjoint: the factors multiply' — the joint fresh cut on the full box
units.sketch: Induction on the clause list. Split the box along the head clause's support (dep localizes sat there; the count field gives the exact head factor p^{|S|−codim} among support assignments); the tail's supports are disjoint from S (Pairwise), so the product factorizes. The k = 0 case is p^m = p^m. THE multi-clause engine consumed by C4.conditionalMass.

units.statement: theorem C2_DOM {lines : ℕ → Line} {i interiorEnd : ℕ} (dom : DomData lines i interiorEnd) (b : ℕ) (hb : b ≤ interiorEnd) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ i) : (lines m).at b ≤ (lines i).at b
units.moves_ref: §C.1 Lemma DOM (interior floor domination), the displayed affine induction (1)+(2)
units.sketch: Affine: line_i(b)−line_m(b) = (line_i−line_m)(interiorEnd) + (slope_i−slope_m)·(interiorEnd−b) ≥ 0 from dom.vertex_entry and dom.steeper (m = i trivial). Pure ℚ/linarith.

units.statement: theorem C2_DOM_floorForm {lines : ℕ → Line} {i interiorEnd : ℕ} (dom : DomData lines i interiorEnd) (b : ℕ) (hb : b ≤ interiorEnd) : floorOf lines i b = (lines i).at b
units.moves_ref: §C.1 DOM floor form: on the factor interior the floor F_i IS the current line
units.sketch: floorOf = sup' over m ≤ i; by C2.DOM every line_m(b) ≤ line_i(b), attained at m = i. Finset.sup'_le + le_sup'.

units.statement: theorem C2_floorH_root (H : History p F) (b : ℕ) : H.floorH 0 b = ⊥
units.moves_ref: §C.1 E_fresh(ν₀) := E(ν₀) (empty floor at the root read); §C.1.5 initialization
units.sketch: take 0 = [], foldr max ⊥ [] = ⊥. Definitional.

units.statement: theorem C2_floorH_succ (H : History p F) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < H.nodes.length) (b : ℕ) : H.floorH (i+1) b = max (H.floorH i b) ((H.nodes[i]'hi).staircase b)
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5 (ZC-a): F_i = pointwise max of the history's line staircases, grown one node at a time
units.sketch: take (i+1) = take i ++ [nodes[i]] (List.take_succ / getElem); foldr max ⊥ (l ++ [a]) = max (foldr max ⊥ l) a by foldr_append + max comm/assoc on the linear order WithBot ℚ.

units.statement: theorem C2_freshFree {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < H.nodes.length) : ∀ cl ∈ (J.fresh i).clauses, ∀ c ∈ cl.support, (J.Sigma i).pinned c = false
units.moves_ref: §C.1(ii): E_fresh's realizations constrain only coordinates FREE on Σ_i — now a THEOREM from the (ZC) exact downset + LST(iii) selection links (round-1 audit: freeness was an assumed field of FreshData)
units.sketch: i = 0: J.init (the full box has no pins). i = i'+1: fresh_interior places the support at interior base indices of the rim threshold in J.zc i'; fresh_above puts its height strictly above floorH (i'+1); (J.zc i').downset_exact (pinned ↔ ht ≤ floor, BOTH directions) then forces pinned = false. Genuinely consumes zc + fresh_above + fresh_interior.

units.statement: theorem C2_EInh_implied {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < H.nodes.length) (j : Fin m) (hint : (J.coordOf j).2 < (H.nodes[i]'hi).μ * (H.nodes[i]'hi).childWidth) (hbelow : ((J.ht (J.coordOf j) : ℚ) : WithBot ℚ) ≤ H.floorH (i+1) (J.coordOf j).2) : ∀ x : Fin m → ZMod p, (J.Sigma (i+1)).IsSolution x → x j = 0
units.moves_ref: §C.1(i) CLAIM: on Σ_i every at-or-below-floor clause is implied — the state cylinder FORCES the floor downset to zero (round-1 audit: EInh_implied 'restates hdownset'; now it derives forced zeros from the exact-downset (ZC))
units.sketch: (J.zc i).downset_exact ← direction gives pinned j; interior_zero gives solve j ≡ 0; IsSolution evaluates x j = 0.

units.statement: theorem C3_crossing {old new : Line} (hsteep : old.slope < new.slope) (s0 jstar : ℕ) (hend0 : old.at s0 ≤ new.at s0) (hend1 : old.at jstar ≤ new.at jstar) (b : ℕ) (hb0 : s0 ≤ b) (hb1 : b ≤ jstar) : old.at b ≤ new.at b
units.moves_ref: §C.1(i)(α) THE ENDPOINT/AFFINE-LINE COMPARISON (rev 10): new ≥ old on the span by endpoint interpolation
units.sketch: new−old is affine in b, ≥ 0 at both endpoints ⟹ ≥ 0 on [s0, jstar] (convex interpolation). Pure ℚ/nlinarith on the two endpoint inequalities.

units.statement: theorem C3_crossing_reverse {old new : Line} (hsteep : old.slope < new.slope) (jstar : ℕ) (hend : new.at jstar ≤ old.at jstar) (b : ℕ) (hb : jstar ≤ b) : new.at b ≤ old.at b
units.moves_ref: §C.1(i)(γ) right of the crossing slot j×: the steeper new line stays below old (weaker bound — implied)
units.sketch: new−old strictly decreases in b (slope difference > 0); ≤ 0 at jstar ⟹ ≤ 0 for b ≥ jstar. Pure ℚ/nlinarith.

units.statement: theorem C3_vtxPolyNe {K : Type*} [Field K] (ψ Ranch : Polynomial K) (μ : ℕ) (hmonic : ψ.Monic) (hdeg : 0 < ψ.natDegree) (hord : OrdPsiPoly ψ Ranch μ) : (Ranch /ₘ ψ ^ μ) %ₘ ψ ≠ 0
units.moves_ref: §C.0 the transported vertex value vtx(ν) ∈ F_{i+1}ˣ — its polynomial factor is NONZERO because ord_ψ(Ranch) = μ EXACTLY (Node.hOrd; the z̄-unit factors are units by construction). Instantiated at Node.vtxPoly via Node.hψmonic/hψdeg/hg/hOrd
units.sketch: ψ^μ ∣ Ranch exactly: Ranch = ψ^μ·(Ranch /ₘ ψ^μ) (monic exact division); if the mod were 0 then ψ ∣ quotient, so ψ^{μ+1} ∣ Ranch — contradicting hord.2. Uses dvd_iff_modByMonic at the monic ψ. FLAG (honest residue gap): nonvanishing of the EVALUATION at z̄ needs ψ irreducible over K with K(z̄) ≃ K[z]/ψ — residue-field content not restated here; vtx ≠ 0 is therefore not claimed as a unit.

units.statement: theorem C3_steeperChain (H : History p F) (hcoh : HistoryCoherent H) (i j : ℕ) (hj : j < H.nodes.length) (hij : i < j) : (H.nodes[i]'(lt_trans hij hj)).line.slope < (H.nodes[j]'hj).line.slope
units.moves_ref: §C DOM(1) (I-aug) along the whole history: the recorded lines strictly steepen — supplies DomData.steeper for the history's lines (round-1 audit: 'coherence unconsumed by the theorems' — this and every JetSetup unit consume it)
units.sketch: Induction on j: the consecutive-steeper clause of HistoryCoherent chains transitively.

units.statement: theorem C4_conditionalMass {m : ℕ} (Sigma : Locus p m) (fd : FreshData p m) (hfree : ∀ cl ∈ fd.clauses, ∀ c ∈ cl.support, Sigma.pinned c = false) : Nat.card {x : Fin m → ZMod p // Sigma.IsSolution x ∧ fd.sat x} * p ^ fd.mstar = Sigma.mass
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5'(1): mass(Σ_i ∩ stratum(ν_{i+1})) = mass(Σ_i)·vol_nom(E_fresh) — THE per-step conditional exactness, address-free (Route B)
units.sketch: C0.solvedGraph turns solutions of Σ into free-coordinate assignments, FIXING the values at free coordinates; each clause depends only on its support, which lies inside the free coordinates (hfree), so fd.sat transports to the free box; C1.clausesCount (transported along the order-embedding free ↪ Fin m, support cards/codims unchanged) gives the exact joint factor p^{−mstar} of the free box p^{m−numPinned} = Σ.mass. No lead is ever named (C15 S4b).

units.statement: theorem C4_stepMass {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < H.nodes.length) : (J.Sigma (i+1)).mass * p ^ (J.fresh i).mstar = (J.Sigma i).mass
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5'(1)+(2) mass clause: Σ_{i+1} = Θ_i(Σ_i ∩ E_fresh(ν_i)), moves preserve mass
units.sketch: J.recursion identifies Σ_{i+1}'s solutions with the Θ_i-pullback of {Σ_i ∧ sat}; Θ_i is bijective (C0.unitriBij on J.Theta_uni), so C0.moveMass transports the count; C4.conditionalMass with hfree := C2.freshFree i gives the factor.

units.statement: theorem C4_numPinnedStep {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < H.nodes.length) : (J.Sigma (i+1)).numPinned = (J.Sigma i).numPinned + (J.fresh i).mstar
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5' (ZC-c) codimension bookkeeping, read off the masses via PIN-WELLDEF (no addresses)
units.sketch: Write both masses as p-powers (C0.digitSystemMass), combine with C4.stepMass: p^{m−K'}·p^{a} = p^{m−K} with K, K' ≤ m forces K' = K + a (Nat.pow injectivity, p ≥ 2; the ℕ-subtraction is safe since numPinned ≤ m).

units.statement: theorem C5_massRec {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ H.nodes.length) : (J.Sigma k).numPinned = (Finset.range k).sum (fun i => (J.fresh i).mstar)
units.moves_ref: §C.2 proof spine: the (ZC-c) mass recursion along the prefix, INITIALIZED (round-1 audit: massRec was false at k = 0 through the root off-by-one; Sigma 0 is now the full box by JetSetup.init and each fresh i is consumed exactly once)
units.sketch: Induction on k: base — J.init makes every pinned false, numPinned (Sigma 0) = 0 = empty sum; step — C4.numPinnedStep adds (fresh k).mstar.

units.statement: theorem C5_massCodim {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ H.nodes.length) : (J.Sigma k).mass = p ^ (m - (Finset.range k).sum (fun i => (J.fresh i).mstar))
units.moves_ref: §C.1.5 (ZC-c): mass(Σ_{k−1}) = p^{nN}·∏_{i<k} vol_nom(E_fresh(ν_i)), division-free
units.sketch: Rewrite C0.digitSystemMass by C5.massRec.

units.statement: theorem C6_transportedAdmissible {m : ℕ} (Sigma Z : Locus p m) (hZ : AdmissibleZ Sigma Z) : Nat.card {x : Fin m → ZMod p // Sigma.IsSolution x ∧ Z.IsSolution x} * p ^ Z.numPinned = Sigma.mass
units.moves_ref: §C.2 'After ν_k, append Z: its equations solve only for coordinates free on Σ_k, so Z cuts exactly vol(Z)'
units.sketch: Build the join system: pinned := Sigma.pinned ∨ Z.pinned (DISJOINT by hZ), solve := Sigma's where Sigma pins else Z's; its solutions are exactly the conjunction; numPinned adds; conclude by C0.digitSystemMass on both sides (exponent arithmetic with the disjoint-union bound ≤ m).

units.statement: theorem C6_psiBij {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (k : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (J.Psi k)
units.moves_ref: §C.2 Ψ_H = Θ_k∘…∘Θ_0 is a global digit-level bijection (Fact A/B) — about the RECORDED composite JetSetup.Psi (round-1 audit: psiBij was a two-map composition lemma with no history composition)
units.sketch: Induction on k: Psi 0 = id; Psi (k+1) = Psi k ∘ Theta k (the seg equation at i = 0, if-branch true); each Theta is bijective by C0.unitriBij on J.Theta_uni; compositions of bijections.

units.statement: theorem C6_transportedSystem {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ H.nodes.length) (x : Fin m → ZMod p) : (J.Sigma k).IsSolution x ↔ ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < k), (J.fresh i).sat (J.seg i k x)
units.moves_ref: §C.2 Theorem C(a), first clause: S(H,Z) is exactly the solution locus of T(H,Z) = ∪_i Θ*-transported fresh systems — the state cylinder IS the joint transported fresh system
units.sketch: Induction on k. k = 0: Sigma 0 has no pins (init) so IsSolution is vacuous; the RHS is empty. Step: J.recursion unfolds Sigma (k+1) at x into Sigma k (Theta k x) ∧ sat_k (Theta k x); the IH rebinds through seg i (k+1) x = seg i k (Theta k x) (i ≤ k) and seg k (k+1) x = Theta k x, both definitional.

units.statement: theorem C6_thmC_a {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (Z : Locus p m) (hZ : AdmissibleZ (J.Sigma H.nodes.length) Z) : Function.Bijective (J.Psi H.nodes.length) ∧ Nat.card {y : Fin m → ZMod p // ∃ x : Fin m → ZMod p, (J.Sigma H.nodes.length).IsSolution x ∧ Z.IsSolution x ∧ y = J.Psi H.nodes.length x} = Nat.card {x : Fin m → ZMod p // (J.Sigma H.nodes.length).IsSolution x ∧ Z.IsSolution x}
units.moves_ref: §C.2 THEOREM C(a) [rev 9, on loci]: S(H,Z) = Ψ_H^{-1}(Σ_k ∩ locus Z), carried BIJECTIVELY with equal mass — stated about the recorded composite at the FULL history length, admissibility against the FINAL state (round-1 audit: 'generic bijection cardinality tautology' — repaired: the subtypes are the actual image locus S(H,Z) and the actual final joint locus)
units.sketch: First clause: C6.psiBij. Second: the image subtype under an injective map has the source's cardinality (Equiv on subtypes via Set.imageFactorization / Nat.card_congr). Coherence + realizability are consumed through J (its fields), matching §C's quantifier over realizable lift-carrying histories.

units.statement: theorem C6_thmC_b {n N m : ℕ} {H : History p F} (J : JetSetup H n N m) (Z : Locus p m) (hZ : AdmissibleZ (J.Sigma H.nodes.length) Z) : Nat.card {y : Fin m → ZMod p // ∃ x : Fin m → ZMod p, (J.Sigma H.nodes.length).IsSolution x ∧ Z.IsSolution x ∧ y = J.Psi H.nodes.length x} * p ^ totalPins J Z = boxMass p m
units.moves_ref: §C.2 THEOREM C(b): #{f mod p^N ∈ S(H,Z)} = p^{nN}·∏_{i≤k} vol(E_fresh(ν_i))·vol(Z) — division-free pin arithmetic (mass·p^K = p^{nN}, K = Σ m* + |pins Z|), about the ACTUAL image locus S(H,Z) under the recorded Ψ_H, with m = n·N (JetSetup.hm), coherence + realizability inside J, and Z admissible against the FINAL state (round-1 audit: the k = 0 countermodel and the unconstrained-Dfin existential are both gone)
units.sketch: C6.thmC_a equates the image count with the final joint-locus count; C6.transportedAdmissible peels vol(Z); C5.massCodim/massRec (k = H.nodes.length) give mass(Σ_final) = p^{m−Σm*}; exponent arithmetic assembles mass·p^{Σm*+|pins Z|} = p^m = boxMass.
